about: Ten useful AI tips, ranked. A full-bleed cover scene, then one card per tip: an outlined rank number, the real tool logo on a cream tile, the task in two-tone capitals, a dark prompt bar saying what to click or type, and a five bar meter for how much time it gives back. The close asks readers to pick one tip today. Sources, dates and logo credits go in the post description.
